comments.note: mcp_client.py get_mcp_tools() docstring (line ~178) states 'The toolkit's subprocess is NOT stopped after this call' but the implementation wraps the call in `async with MCPToolkit.from_config(config) as toolkit:`, which does stop the subprocess on exit via __aexit__. The docstring is factually incorrect and should be corrected to: 'The toolkit context is entered and exited within this helper; the subprocess IS stopped when the coroutine returns. Use MCPToolkit directly as an async context manager if you need persistent access to the live tools.'

mcp_client.py _sync_cleanup() uses asyncio.get_event_loop() (line ~165) which is deprecated in Python 3.12+ and raises DeprecationWarning when no running loop exists. Replace with: try: loop = asyncio.get_running_loop() except RuntimeError: loop = asyncio.new_event_loop(). Already noted by the implementation team; carry forward to WP-007 cleanup pass.

utils/logging.py _slugify() applies .strip('-') BEFORE [:max_len], so if the slug has a hyphen exactly at position max_len the resulting log filename ends with a hyphen (e.g. '20260225T080000-my-very-long-label-.jsonl'). Fix: apply strip after slice: _SLUG_RE.sub('-', text.lower())[:max_len].strip('-'). Cosmetic only; no functional impact.
